name: feature-validation-loop
description: Portable feature, test, defect, and remediation validation loop with a canonical CSV ledger and Prismatic Thread artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Validate product behavior with a canonical ledger.
interface.longDescription: End-to-end product behavior validation loop for application repositories. Discovers code-derived user-facing features, maintains a canonical CSV ledger, generates test scenarios, records defects, fixes verified functional or UX issues, retests, and publishes Prismatic Thread summaries when configured.
defaultPrompt: Discover every user-facing feature, maintain the canonical validation ledger, test behavior, fix verified defects, and publish Prismatic Thread artifacts.
Create or update the feature validation ledger and generate the standalone HTML report.
